plan.notes: SOURCE: official SUNY Cobleskill College Catalog 2026-2027, 'Information Technology (B.T.)' (Curriculum Code - 2045/HEGIS - 0799), 'Suggested Course Sequencing' (catalog p. 70): https://arts.cobleskill.edu/academics/registrar/latest-catalog.pdf (PDF downloaded 2026-09-30; transcribed via pdftotext -layout from the two-column sequencing table). DEGREE HONESTY: SUNY Cobleskill offers NO degree named Computer Science. Its true computing bachelor's is the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Information Technology (BT Information Technology). This plan uses the true degree name and type. CATALOG YEAR: 2026-2027 (printed on the catalog pages). TOTAL CREDITS: 122 — the catalog's published degree total (Major Field Requirements 40 + Advisement Track 39 + Liberal Arts & Sciences 34 + General Electives 9). The official suggested sequencing sums to exactly 122 on the MATH 125 path (Y1: 17+15, Y2: 15+15, Y3: 16+18, Y4: 14+12); the MATH 231 (4 cr) option totals 123. TRANSCRIPTION: Advisement Track (39 cr), Liberal Arts and Sciences, and General Elective slots are student-choice placeholders carrying the official per-term credit counts — the catalog names no specific courses in these slots (track courses are chosen with an advisor from one of the 5 official advisement tracks: Application and Web Development; Network Administration and Support; Information Security; Web Graphics and Design; Information Systems). PREREQ NOTES (catalog course descriptions): CITA 405 requires BADM 249 + junior status (BADM 249 asserted in-plan); CITA 325/325X are co-requisites (sequenced together); CITA 380 requires 30 credits of upper-division courses; CITA 492 requires 2.50 major-field GPA (or dean exemption); BADM 320 requires junior status; BADM 300 lists prerequisites (ENGL 111 or BADM 145, CITA 110) that are not part of this degree's requirements; MATH 125 requires placement per high school transcript or C- or better in MATH 111/112/131 or above. No courses, credits, or prerequisites were invented; every named course and credit value comes from the catalog.
